purpose: desktop login visual planning, not implementation
conceptA: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity desktop website login screen concept for the Chinese campus football product 晓球, wide 16:10 composition. This is a visual planning mockup, not an illustration poster. The entire page is a unified very pale sage-white background (#f3f6f1 feeling), graphite/deep forest green type and line work, restrained sage-green accents. Sophisticated sparse editorial interface, crisp modern Chinese sans serif, generous whitespace, subtle fine grain, no thick white card and no stark white rectangular right panel, no gradients/glows, no glass dashboard. Left visual occupies about 60%; right form occupies 40%, width approximately 350px, aligned vertically near center. A very thin muted sage vertical dividing line softly fades at top and bottom, never an opaque wall. Both halves share the same material and palette. Small brand at top left: a simple XQ monogram followed by exact Chinese text "晓球". No full-screen icon or unrelated navigation. Right side exact interface text, with clear readable hierarchy: two tabs "登录" "注册"; title "欢迎回来"; description "登录后继续关注你的球队与比赛。"; two small method tabs "账号密码" "邮箱验证码"; label "用户名 / 昵称 / 姓名 / 学号"; account input placeholder "请输入账号信息"; label "密码"; password input placeholder "请输入密码"; small "忘记密码". Inputs are subtly tinted, 52px tall feeling, hairline borders, no surrounding white card. Full-width forest green primary button "登录", and immediately below a same-width outlined button "以游客身份浏览". Small helper "无需注册，先看赛程、比分和球队". Below left visual, modest strong heading exact text "每一场校园比赛，都值得被认真记录" on a single line if space allows and smaller copy "赛程、数据、球队与同学们的现场声音，在这里汇成完整赛季。". Keep this copy separate from the visual so it remains readable. Place a SMALL 26px-feeling hand-drawn football cursor over the left visual: a thin graphite circular contour with a tiny outlined central pentagon and just 3 sparse seams, no black filled patches, no glossy realistic football. This cursor is an interaction marker, NOT a separate floating large football decoration. No invented scores, numbers, testimonials, mascots, players or explanatory arrows. Text in Chinese must be accurate. Variant A: PARTICLE PITCH, the recommended direction. The left centerpiece is a floating isometric small football field sandtable, open and lightweight, viewed from about 35 degrees above. Grass surface is formed from thousands of tiny sage/forest-green stippled dots, with sharply legible thin field perimeter, halfway line, center circle, penalty boxes and two delicate outlined goals. Very sparse delicate trees and low sketchy stands suggest a campus pitch without becoming a full architectural stadium. Near the mouse cursor a few dots bend and gently scatter into a small clear wave; the football field shape remains very recognizable. Edges fade into scattered grains and soft emptiness, evocative of interactive point cloud art on a bright minimalist website. This is an airy carefully drawn tangible field, not a planet, not a solid videogame stadium, not a green glossy tile and not an explosion. Two-dimensional/2.5D point-cloud visual as an achievable canvas composition. Large beautiful field with lots of surrounding negative space, diffuse almost imperceptible contact shadow; subdued pale background continuously spans the right form.

conceptBRefinement: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a targeted correction of an existing Chinese website login visual planning mockup. Keep the entire image, composition, football field pencil sandtable, background, all Chinese typography, form, buttons, branding and colors unchanged. Change only the mouse interaction marker near the lower-center area of the football pitch. Remove the dark conventional arrow pointer completely. Replace the existing small shaded soccer ball with ONE very simple flat pencil-outline football cursor at exactly that location: a thin dark green/graphite circle, a tiny outlined central pentagon, and only three sparse connecting seams, no solid black patches, no glossy shading, no 3D ball. Its diameter should be around 22 pixels relative to this image, small and clean. Remove any circular ripple rings immediately surrounding the cursor so there is no double cursor. Do not add a pointer arrow anywhere in the left football pitch region. Preserve everything else precisely.
